backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a Hindu devotional app, defining data types (Katha, Aarti, Temple, CommunityPost, etc.) and state maps, with mixins for blob storage, authorization, and user approval.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms the old Katha type (without `audioBlob`) to the new type (with optional `audioBlob` set to null) for all entries in the `kathayen` map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features with their IDs, titles, associated files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels for the admin panel, audio upload, and community post fixes.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key implementation details, serving as a reference for build planning.
frontend/.env.example: Example environment file documenting the optional Google Gemini API key configuration, noting it is stored client-side and never sent to the backend.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS base styles defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that mounts the React app into a `#root` div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes under an `AppLayout` shell, wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `AuthProvider`.
frontend/src/components/AartiCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays an Aarti's name, Hindi text preview, and deity tag, navigating to the Aarti detail route on click.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main application layout component that renders the sticky header with auth controls, notification banners, bottom navigation, and a router outlet for page content.
frontend/src/components/AuthModal.tsx: Modal dialog for user login with username/password fields, error display, and calls the useAuth hook's login function on submission.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar rendering links to all major app sections with active-state highlighting and emoji icons.
frontend/src/components/ChatMessage.tsx: Renders a single chat message bubble with role-based styling and optional text-to-speech controls (play/pause/stop) using the useSpeechNarration hook.
frontend/src/components/ChatTypingIndica: Displays an animated three-dot typing indicator with an AI avatar, shown while the AI is generating a response.
frontend/src/components/CommunityPostCar: Renders a community post card with author avatar, post content, optional image/video/file attachments, like button, and time-ago timestamp.
frontend/src/components/DailyDharmaQuote: Displays a styled daily dharma quote card with Hindi and English text fetched via useGetDharmaQuote, falling back to a hardcoded Bhagavad Gita quote while loading.
frontend/src/components/EkadashiReminder: Displays a dismissible banner reminding users of upcoming Ekadashi dates (within 7 days) with Hindi messages; dismissal state is persisted in sessionStorage per day.
frontend/src/components/FestivalCountdow: Renders a styled card showing a Hindu festival's name, description, and countdown in days, with a share button that uses the Web Share API or clipboard fallback.
frontend/src/components/FloatingLotus.ts: Renders six semi-transparent lotus petal images fixed to the background with CSS float animations at varying positions, delays, and durations.
frontend/src/components/GoldenHalo.tsx: A wrapper component that renders a pulsing radial-gradient golden halo behind its children, with configurable size via numeric or named presets.
frontend/src/components/KathaCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a Hindu katha (story) showing deity emoji, title, truncated Hindi text, and category/deity badges, navigating to the katha detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/Loader.tsx: A loading spinner component that displays a spinning mandala image with an Om symbol overlay and an optional text label in three size variants.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: A login/logout button using Internet Identity; shows loading, authenticated, and unauthenticated states and clears the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/LotusBloomOverla: A full-screen animated overlay triggered by a numeric prop that celebrates completing 108 japa repetitions with a lotus image, petal burst particles, and Hindi congratulatory text.
frontend/src/components/MalaRing.tsx: Renders an animated canvas-based mala (prayer bead ring) with 108 beads, filling beads based on a count prop, a slowly rotating ring, and a breathing Om symbol in the center.
frontend/src/components/NotificationBann: Displays a styled in-app notification banner for namjap, aarti, or vrat types with a 10-second auto-dismiss progress bar and a manual close button.
Renders a short-lived particle burst animation of three ॐ symbols radiating outward, auto-hiding after 700ms.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name and saves their profile using the useSaveUserProfile mutation with a default mantra selection.
frontend/src/components/SacredRipple.tsx: Renders up to four concentric ripple ring animations triggered by a numeric prop, each ring expanding and fading over 800ms.
frontend/src/components/ShlokaCard.tsx: Displays a Sanskrit shloka with Hindi and English meanings in a decorative card, with copy-to-clipboard and native share actions.
frontend/src/components/VratModeDashboar: Dashboard component showing Brahma Muhurat times, live countdowns to upcoming Ekadashi and Shivratri dates, and vrat-day ritual checklists.
frontend/src/components/VratModeToggle.t: A toggle switch UI component that enables or disables Vrat Mode, changing its styling and icon based on the active state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning either an anonymous or authenticated actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAIChat.ts: Custom hook managing an AI chat session with localStorage persistence, exposing sendMessage, clearHistory, loading, and error state.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Provides a simple username/password authentication context with hardcoded admin credentials, persisting the logged-in user to localStorage and exposing login/logout functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyNotifications: Schedules 7 daily browser notifications (or in-app banners as fallback) at fixed hours for Hindu devotional reminders (Nam Jap, Aarti, Vrat), with enable/disable persistence via localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login state, identity persistence, and exposing login/clear functions via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for CRUD operations on backend entities (Kathayen, CommunityPosts, JapCounter, DharmaQuotes, Bhajans, Chalisas, Vrats, UserProfiles) using the ICP actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechNarration.ts: Wraps the Web Speech API to provide Hindi text-to-speech narration controls (play, pause, resume, stop) with PWA-friendly voice loading, visibility-based pause/resume, and retry logic on error.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines light/dark CSS custom properties for a Hindu devotional color theme (saffron, gold, maroon), and declares utility classes and keyframe animations.
frontend/src/lib/aiEngine.ts: Calls the Pollinations AI text API with a Hindi Hindu guru system prompt using three fallback strategies (POST, GET with openai, GET with mistral), and returns hardcoded Hindi fallback responses if all requests fail.
frontend/src/lib/aiGuruData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and static data for all 12 zodiac rashis, and provides templated Hindi prediction strings for love and career horoscope aspects used in daily bhavishya generation.
frontend/src/lib/kathaData.ts: Contains static Hindi and English text for Hindu religious stories (kathas) such as Ram Janm and Sita Swayamvar, typed with a StaticKatha interface referencing KathaCategory from the backend.
frontend/src/lib/panchangEngine.ts: Implements astronomical algorithms to compute Hindu Panchang elements—Tithi, Nakshatra, Vara, Yoga, Karana, Paksha, and approximate sunrise/sunset times for India—from a given JavaScript Date.
frontend/src/lib/staticData.ts: Provides static Hindi aarti text and metadata (deity, emoji, gradient color) for major Hindu deities including Ganesh, Shiv, Vishnu, Durga, and Lakshmi.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that mounts the app with React Query and a custom InternetIdentityProvider (ICP authentication) wrapping the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Aarti.tsx: A list page displaying all aartis from static data as navigable cards with emoji icons, linking to individual aarti detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/AartiDetail.tsx: A detail page for a single aarti that shows its Hindi text with controls for text-to-speech playback, copying, and sharing.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: An admin-only panel with tabs for managing Kathayen (add/edit/delete with optional MP3 upload) and moderating community posts (approve/reject/delete).
frontend/src/pages/AIGuru.tsx: A chat interface page for an AI spiritual guide ('दिव्य गुरु') that displays messages, suggested Hindi prompts, a typing indicator, and allows sending/clearing conversations via the useAIChat hook.
frontend/src/pages/Bhajans.tsx: A page listing static bhajan cards with expandable lyrics and per-card text-to-speech playback, supplemented by any bhajans fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/Chalisa.tsx: A page displaying chalisa cards (starting with static Hanuman Chalisa plus any backend entries) with expandable full text and text-to-speech narration support.
frontend/src/pages/Community.tsx: Community page that displays approved community posts and allows authenticated users to create new posts with optional image/video attachments. Shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users and sorts posts by timestamp.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Simple dashboard page that fetches and displays the logged-in user's profile with a welcome message and navigation hint. Shows skeleton loading state while profile data is being fetched.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page featuring a hero banner, daily Panchang strip, category navigation grid (Jap, Aarti, Mantras, etc.), a shloka display, and a vrat mode banner toggle. Integrates DailyDharmaQuote and FloatingLotus decorative components.
frontend/src/pages/Jap.tsx: Mantra Jap (chanting) counter page with a mala ring UI that tracks counts up to 108, triggers a lotus bloom animation on completion, and syncs daily/lifetime/streak stats with the backend.
frontend/src/pages/KathaDetail.tsx: Detail view for a single Katha (religious story) showing Hindi/English text, an audio player component, and speech narration support. Resolves content from either static data or backend based on the route param.
frontend/src/pages/Kathayen.tsx: Kathayen listing page that merges static and backend-fetched stories, supports search and category filter tabs (all/puranik/vrat), and navigates to the KathaDetail page on selection.
frontend/src/pages/Mandir.tsx: Displays a list of famous Hindu temples with live darshan links, Google Maps links, and an animated sacred portal button with ripple/burst effects.
frontend/src/pages/Mantras.tsx: Renders a collection of Hindu mantras as expandable cards with Sanskrit, Hindi, and English text, plus text-to-speech narration support.
frontend/src/pages/Panchang.tsx: Shows a Hindu Panchang (almanac) for a selected date with navigable date controls, displaying tithi, nakshatra, vara, yoga, karana, paksha, sunrise/sunset, and auspicious muhurtas.
frontend/src/pages/Profile.tsx: User profile page showing jap (chanting) stats, admin badge, vrat mode toggle, and logout; redirects unauthenticated users to a login prompt.
frontend/src/pages/VratDashboard.tsx: Vrat (fasting) dashboard displaying countdown timers to upcoming Hindu fasting dates, a sattvic food guide, and a daily vrat checklist.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors (saffron, gold, maroon, cream), custom font families, border radius variables, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project state document describing a Katha religious-stories app with known bugs (admin panel errors, broken TTS, hidden community posts) and planned features including MP3 upload, audio playback, and community feed fixes.
